About

I am a graduate researcher in biochemistry at Chattogram Veterinary and Animal Sciences University. My MSc thesis asks how common food additives affect lifespan and healthspan in the nematode Caenorhabditis elegans — using a whole animal to ask a question that a cell line cannot answer.

The work runs across the bench and the terminal. As an Honorary Research Assistant at CVASU I maintain C. elegans cultures and their E. coli food strains (OP50, HB101), prepare solvent extracts of plant material, and carry the work from data collection through processing, visualization, analysis and interpretation. As a Junior Research Collaborator at ABCD Laboratory I handle literature review and natural-compound screening for computer-aided drug design.

Alongside the thesis I contribute to anthelmintic screening of Bangladeshi and Canadian plant extracts against C. elegans and Haemonchus contortus, a dose-response study of Nigella sativa and Momordica charantia in diabetic mice, and a narrative review on endoplasmic reticulum stress and the unfolded protein response. I have co-authored three peer-reviewed papers.

I completed my BSc in Biochemistry & Molecular Biology at Gopalganj Science & Technology University in 2024. Outside the laboratory I volunteer with BD CLEAN, CVASU BADHAN, the Thalassemia Welfare Centre and Volunteer for Bangladesh.

Wet lab experience

  • Detection and confirmation of Salmonella spp. in food samples by conventional PCR and agarose gel electrophoresis
  • DNA isolation from blood of thalassemia patients
  • microRNA isolation and detection through RT-PCR
  • Culture, sub-culturing and stock preservation of bacterial isolates under aseptic conditions — E. coli (OP50, HB101), Salmonella spp., Staphylococcus aureus, Enterococcus faecalis and Lactobacillus acidophilus
  • Identification and quantification of albumin by colorimetric ELISA
  • Quantification of cholesterol in egg yolk using a Humalyzer 3000 semi-automated biochemistry analyzer
  • Quantification of vitamin D content in egg yolk samples on a Finecare immunoassay analyzer
  • Preparation and microscopic examination of histological sections of colorectal cancer tissue
  • Sequential solvent extraction of plant material using n-hexane, methanol and dichloromethane, with PVPP treatment for polyphenol removal
  • Optimization of PVPP concentration against a gallic acid reference standard for polyphenol removal from plant extracts
  • Maintenance and L1 synchronization of Caenorhabditis elegans cultures by bleaching, egg collection and hatching
  • Anthelmintic activity screening of Bangladeshi plant extracts against C. elegans and Haemonchus contortus
